data.name: Hotel Portobelo
data.address: Av Juárez 687, Zona Centro, 44100 Guadalajara, Jal., Mexico
data.description:
A 15-minute walk from Guadalajara Cathedral, this casual city hotel on a bustling street is 1 km from Museo Regional de Guadalajara (museum) and 2 km from San Juan de Dios Market.
Featuring wood floors and sitting areas, the streamlined rooms come with free Wi-Fi and flat-screen TVs. Suites include in-room whilrpool tubs. Room service is available 24/7.
There's a low-key restaurant, as well as a lobby bar with a flat-screen TV. Parking is complimentary.
